_description: One line describing what this profile is for - shown by `uxc profiles` and in the LuCI dropdown.
_comment: Boilerplate profile. Copy to <name>.json and apply with --profile <name>. Every key starting with '_' is a directive or a comment and never reaches config.json. Merge rules: objects merge recursively, mounts merge BY DESTINATION, other arrays append, scalars replace. See profiles/README.md.
_comment_caps: Capabilities ADDED on top of the --caps set. This is what you almost always want. (Writing process.capabilities instead REPLACES the whole set - that scopes a container down, but forget CAP_CHOWN and its init dies on the first chown.)
_comment_mounts: Bundle-side mounts. Prefer _registry.volumes below for data binds - those are visible and editable in LuCI. Use this section for things only the OCI config can express, such as a sized tmpfs. A mount marked _optional is skipped when its host source does not exist, instead of failing the container.
_comment_registry: The uxcd side of the container (/etc/uxc/<name>.json): everything an OCI config cannot say. Only keys the entry does not already have are written, so re-pulls and upgrades never overwrite the user's edits.

_registry._comment_devices: Device nodes AND directories. A directory (/dev/dri, /dev/bus/usb) is bind-mounted live and allowed by major number, so hotplug and re-enumeration keep working. Devices that do not exist on this host are skipped.
_registry._comment_shm: Sized /dev/shm when the app needs more than the default. This is RAM.
_registry.notes: Anything the next person needs to know before touching this container.
